title: Explore Campus
description: Tools for finding your way around campus: campus events from UW-Madison and the Wisconsin Union, and Madison Metro bus connections from a housing address to campus buildings.

blocks.title: Explore Campus
blocks.lead: What is on, and how to get there.
body: Two tools, each reading a public source and naming it. Badger Supports programs are labelled as ours; everything else keeps its own organizer and a link to its official listing.

items.title: Campus Events
lines: UW-Madison Events · Wisconsin Union · Badger Supports
items.text: Campus events in one explorer: search, filter by interest, and switch between a calendar and a list. Find Your People gathers clubs, communities and social gatherings.

items.title: Bus Routes from Home
items.text: Compare several housing addresses against the campus buildings you pick: a direct bus, one transfer, or no suitable connection. No times, schedules or predictions.

blocks.title: Where the listings come from
body: Event listings come from UW-Madison Events and the Wisconsin Union event calendar; Badger Supports programs come from Badger Supports Connect. Bus routes come from Madison Metro's published route data, and addresses are placed with OpenStreetMap. Nothing you type into a tool here is kept.
